headline: FloydMayweather has his eyes on the next generation, and he believes his grandson KJ could
body: FloydMayweather has his eyes on the next generation, and he believes his grandson KJ could one day become the future of boxing. The boxing legend recently shared his thoughts on his grandson, who is the son of YoungBoy Never Broke Again, suggesting that he could have a bright future in the sport as he gets older. According to Floyd, the young boy already shows an interest in being around the gym and wants to be there 24/7.
